name: RegEvidenceHub
description: Technologies RegEvidence inc. portfolio catalog: RegEvidenceHub has five UK Regulatory Readiness products and three Industrial Quality Assurance products.

routing.human: Use humanEntry for guided workflows or product information. Industrial file audits require a supported MCP client.
routing.agent: Use url only where a payment-free connector is provided. Use commercialUrl for paid decisions. Industrial entries list their freeTools separately; full audits are metered.

entries.name: UK Taxi PHV Licensing
entries.humanAction: Start a free licensing readiness check; full report price is shown before payment.

entries.name: CQC Provider Compliance
entries.humanAction: Start a free structured statutory-notification readiness check; qualified cases can continue to a paid report.
entries.humanPayment: Stripe checkout; price confirmed before payment

entries.name: UK Premises Licence Preflight
entries.humanAction: Start a structured premises-licensing report workflow; current report offer is confirmed before payment.

entries.name: England Works Watch
entries.humanAction: Create a Sponsor Decision Evidence Check — £49 for a dated GOV.UK evidence checkpoint plus 30-day private re-check access; no subscription or alerts.

entries.name: RegEvidenceHub Waste
entries.humanAction: Start free readiness, then review the £19 report offer with 24-hour access before payment.

entries.name: CableCert QA
entries.humanAction: Review product scope; free CSV inspection is not the full audit.
entries.humanPayment: $0.01 USDC per MCP audit; shared-platform offer $19 USD for one report, 24-hour redemption.

entries.name: FactoryTalk Import Preflight
entries.humanAction: Review supported CSV scope; connect an MCP client to run a paid audit.
entries.humanPayment: $0.007 USDC per MCP call; no prepaid package is listed in the current shared-platform product registry.

entries.name: OPC UA NodeSet Compatibility Gate
entries.humanAction: Review supported XML scope; free status and upload setup do not run the audit.
entries.humanPayment: $0.005 USDC per MCP audit; no prepaid package is listed in the current shared-platform product registry.
